description: ST Wasserschutzgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In the INSPIRE View service of the BfG, the water and health spring protection areas of the state of Saxony-Anhalt are presented together as drinking water protection areas and health spring protection areas in the layer water protection areas. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WFS ST Water Protection Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Trinkwasserschutzgebiete, Wasserschutzgebiete, inspireidentifiziert, Heilquellenschutzgebiete, Umweltdatenbank. The listing shows 2024-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
